parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Valid values: **1** to **100000**. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of domain names to return on each page. Valid values: an integer from **1** to **500**. Default value: **20**.

parameters.name: PolicyId
parameters.description: The ID of the protection policy. You can specify only one ID in each request.
